text:
anya: kicking off a short scoped thread for Evidence Sprint. Need to lock MVP acceptance for audits + BYOK before RFC. @mike @jules please.
mike: ok. propose MVP = tenant TTLs (30/90/365), signed export manifest (sha256+signer id), BYOK pointer to KMS arn, admin action logs included. no per-model TTLs.
jules: infra: export pipeline reads append-only audit stream, packages JSONL, computes digests, signs manifest, uploads to secure bucket. estimate 2w infra + 1w product.
legal: require chain-of-custody doc, manifest canonicalization rules, and key rotation events included. signed manifest must state signature algorithm + key id.
anya: acceptance checklist: 1) TTL enforcement tested, 2) signed export delivered for sample window, 3) BYOK handshake doc + pilot, 4) SOC2 mapping sign-off. SLO: export ready within 24h.
mike: API sketch for export request: POST /v1/tenants/:tid/exports {"start","end","format":"tar+jsonl","signed":true} -> async job id.
jules: risk: purge job failure. include tombstone entries in exports and alerting. also rate-limit export size; big requests go to concierge.
infra-bot: automatic message - created ticket EPIC-208888: evidence-mvp, assigned to mike, jules.
anya: owners assigned. If no objections by EOD we lock scope and start RFC. :thumbsup:
mike: no objections.
jules: good for infra.
